title: idea net
excerpt: How many words does one word pull?
content_html:
$whoami

One person. Wrote it, use it every day. No team, no roadmap — I add whatever I feel like.

$cat idea-net.md

# How many words does one word pull?

Give it a starting point and it grows along the meaning: close extensions, jumps across fields, and the odd link that takes a beat before it clicks.

  • ›Ideas aren't listed. They're pulled.
  • ›You think you're chasing an answer — you're chasing the next word.
  • ›One choice at a time: the word you tap is the way it grows.
  • ›Every fork you didn't take stays on the map.

$tree cache

   cache ─┬── write-through ── pay now, or pay later
          ├── invalidation ·· one of the two hard things
          └── stale read ──── eventual consistency
                   └── CRDT ── merge without asking

$./idea-net --seed <your word>

start weavingNo signup. Type a word and go — the graph lives in your browser.

$./idea-net --check-engine

…checking this browser…
